claim: 'Other top formulations such as 76-, 77-, 113-, 306-, and 400-O16CBA-F1 induced delivery efficacies of 78-83%'
locus_A: RESULTS, 'R-O16CBA LNPs for mRNA Delivery', paragraph 3 (JATS text)
what_we_emitted: the figure's values (84.93 and 88.51 for 76- and 77-O16CBA-F1)
why: Two of the five named formulations sit ABOVE the printed band, and 80-O16CBA-F1 at 85.25% is higher than three formulations the sentence does list yet is not named at all, so the sentence is a loose summary rather than a measurement. The figure read is independently corroborated: the band's own F2 counterpart ('57-73%') reproduces at BOTH endpoints (57.26, 73.21), the two printed maxima are the correct members, the two printed counts (8 below 15%, 9 above 50%) are exact, and all 33 pairwise sign statements hold with exactly the two stated exceptions. 83% is at row 94.9 px; the 76- and 77-F1 tops are at rows 89 and 78, which is above it by 6 and 17 px - far outside any plausible read error. Recorded as check P6b, non-gating.
severity: changes no emitted value; the paper's prose is the thing that is wrong

claim: Figure 2F's column is headed 'Formula' but the formulas are those of the PROTONATED ion
locus_B: 75-O16CBA is printed as C52H85N2O14. The neutral molecule is C52H84N2O14; C52H85N2O14 is [M+H]+. The same holds for all eleven rows.
what_we_emitted: the neutral formula, and the [M+H]+ reading of their column when comparing
why: Read as neutral formulas, every one of the eleven printed 'Cal. [M+H]+' values would be 1.008 Da too low. Read as [M+H]+ formulas, our recomputation of their own formulas agrees with their own calculated m/z to 0.0048 Da over all eleven (check P1b). The column is mislabelled, and the mislabel is harmless only because the adjacent column disambiguates it.
severity: cosmetic in the paper; would have been a 1.008 Da systematic error for any curator who read it literally

claim: 'Further studies will focus on the R-16CBA-F1 LNPs'
locus_A: RESULTS, 'R-O16CBA LNPs for mRNA Delivery', final paragraph
locus_B: every other occurrence in the paper writes 'R-O16CBA'
why: A dropped letter. Recorded because a name-keyed join is exactly where a one-character typo does damage (CLAUDE.md section 3, 288 cross-experiment name collisions).

claim: 'The results revealed that the R-O16CBA lipidoid can be completely degraded at pH 5.'
locus_B: The quantitative degradation kinetic (Figure 3B) is measured at pH 4.5 and 7.2 ONLY: 25/60/88/99% at 1/4/8/24 h. pH 5.0 appears only in the qualitative ESI-MS panel (Figure 3E) and in the RESULTS as 'Samples treated with pH 5.0 conditions revealed very similar results as those at pH 4.5'.
what_we_emitted: nothing - no degradation value is a corpus row
why: The abstract states at pH 5 a completeness that was quantified at pH 4.5. Recorded because the pH-responsiveness is the paper's headline claim and a reader may cite the abstract's number.
